Quantum 1.9.0 was certified on 2026-07-21. It pins **nucleus v1.5.0**, **quark v1.4.0** and **orbit v1.5.0**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.8.0: nucleus goes from v1.4.0 to v1.5.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.3.3 to v1.4.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.4.4 to v1.5.0 (minor).
